item.title: Customer Personality Analysis
item.author: Avishek Saha
item.description: Background In the competitive landscape of modern business, understanding and catering to the diverse needs of customers is crucial for sustainable growth. A leading retail company, “XYZ Mart,” aimed to enhance its marketing strategies by gaining deeper insights into customer behavior and preferences. As part of this endeavor, the company embarked on a project to analyze customer personalities and segment them effectively. Problem Statement XYZ Mart faced challenges in effectively targeting its marketing efforts due to a lack of precise customer segmentation.
